   * - afterAll: DO NOTHING (keep evidence for inspection)

   * After tests run, you can cd into test/data and inspect/test manually.
   */
  beforeAll(async () => {

**Date:** 2025-10-30-UTC-0832

**Role:** Full-Stack Developer

**📎 Previous Commit:** d82c73aa0 (path-separation-violation-fix)  
**🔗 Previous PDCA:** [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/session/2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/session/2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md](session/2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md)

## Summary

### Problem Statement

User feedback: "see the folders in test/data, but the component artifacts are gone. the ruel is to clean before the next test run and let the test results - the evidence - in test/data without deleting it. test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root."

**Current Violation:**

```typescript
// ❌ WRONG: test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:33-40
afterAll(async () => {
  // Cleanup: Remove created test component
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components', testComponentName);
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });  // ❌ DELETES EVIDENCE!
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned up: ${testComponentName}`);
  }
});
```

**Correct Pattern:**
- ✅ **beforeAll:** Clean test/data (remove old evidence)
- ✅ **Test runs:** Create components in test/data
- ✅ **afterAll:** DO NOTHING - keep evidence for inspection
- ✅ **Next run:** beforeAll cleans again (fresh start)

**Key Principle:**
> test/data becomes a **testable alternate isolated project root** - it should contain EVIDENCE of what the tests created, allowing manual inspection and validation.

### Artifact Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts](test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts) - Has wrong cleanup (to fix)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/.gitignore) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/.gitignore](test/data/.gitignore) - To create (ignore evidence in git)

### QA Decisions

**Decision 1: When to clean test/data?**
- [x] a) beforeAll (clean before tests run) - CORRECT
- [ ] b) afterAll (clean after tests run) - WRONG (removes evidence)
- [ ] c) Never clean (accumulates cruft)

**Decision 2: Should test/data be in git?**
- [x] a) No - add .gitignore (local evidence only)
- [ ] b) Yes - commit evidence to git
- [ ] c) Only commit structure, not contents

**Decision 3: What to clean in beforeAll?**
- [x] a) Remove entire test/data/components directory (full reset)
- [ ] b) Remove only specific test component
- [ ] c) Remove and recreate test/data

---

## Plan

### Root Cause Analysis

**Why this exists:**
- Traditional test pattern: "clean up after yourself"
- But for **evidence-based testing**, we want artifacts to persist
- test/data is NOT production - it's a sandbox for inspection
- Each test run should start fresh but LEAVE evidence

**Impact:**
- ❌ Cannot inspect test results manually
- ❌ Cannot verify generated file structure
- ❌ Cannot debug test failures (evidence deleted)
- ✅ But: Test isolation DOES work (just removes evidence)

**Correct Pattern (Evidence-Based Testing):**

1. **beforeAll:** Clean slate (remove old evidence)
2. **Tests run:** Create components, verify structure
3. **Tests pass/fail:** Results visible in test/data
4. **afterAll:** DO NOTHING (keep evidence)
5. **Developer:** Can cd to test/data and inspect/run commands
6. **Next run:** beforeAll cleans old evidence, creates new

### Goals

1. ✅ **Change cleanup timing:**
   - Move cleanup from afterAll to beforeAll
   - Remove afterAll hook entirely

2. ✅ **Add .gitignore for test/data:**
   - Ignore components/ subdirectory
   - Ignore scripts/ subdirectory
   - Keep .gitignore itself in git

3. ✅ **Document the pattern:**
   - Add comment explaining evidence persistence
   - Reference this PDCA in test file

4. ✅ **Verify evidence persists:**
   - Run tests
   - Verify test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent exists
   - Verify can cd into it and inspect

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] afterAll() hook removed from test
- [ ] beforeAll() cleans test/data/components
- [ ] Tests create components in test/data
- [ ] After tests run, evidence remains in test/data
- [ ] test/data/.gitignore created (ignores components/)
- [ ] All 51 tests still pass
- [ ] Can manually inspect test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/

# PDCA: Test Evidence Persistence - test/data as Isolated Project Root

**Date:** 2025-10-30-UTC-0832  
**Objective:** Make test/data persist as testable evidence - clean before tests, keep results after  
**Role:** Full-Stack Developer  
**Template Version:** 3.2.4.2  
**Issues Found:** afterAll() cleanup removes test evidence - violates inspection principle  
**📎 Previous Commit:** d82c73aa0 (path-separation-violation-fix)  
**🔗 Previous PDCA:** [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/session/2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/session/2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md](session/2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md)

---

## Summary

### Problem Statement

User feedback: "see the folders in test/data, but the component artifacts are gone. the ruel is to clean before the next test run and let the test results - the evidence - in test/data without deleting it. test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root."

**Current Violation:**

```typescript
// ❌ WRONG: test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:33-40
afterAll(async () => {
  // Cleanup: Remove created test component
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components', testComponentName);
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });  // ❌ DELETES EVIDENCE!
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned up: ${testComponentName}`);
  }
});
```

**Correct Pattern:**
- ✅ **beforeAll:** Clean test/data (remove old evidence)
- ✅ **Test runs:** Create components in test/data
- ✅ **afterAll:** DO NOTHING - keep evidence for inspection
- ✅ **Next run:** beforeAll cleans again (fresh start)

**Key Principle:**
> test/data becomes a **testable alternate isolated project root** - it should contain EVIDENCE of what the tests created, allowing manual inspection and validation.

### Artifact Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts](test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts) - Has wrong cleanup (to fix)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/.gitignore) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/.gitignore](test/data/.gitignore) - To create (ignore evidence in git)

### QA Decisions

**Decision 1: When to clean test/data?**
- [x] a) beforeAll (clean before tests run) - CORRECT
- [ ] b) afterAll (clean after tests run) - WRONG (removes evidence)
- [ ] c) Never clean (accumulates cruft)

**Decision 2: Should test/data be in git?**
- [x] a) No - add .gitignore (local evidence only)
- [ ] b) Yes - commit evidence to git
- [ ] c) Only commit structure, not contents

**Decision 3: What to clean in beforeAll?**
- [x] a) Remove entire test/data/components directory (full reset)
- [ ] b) Remove only specific test component
- [ ] c) Remove and recreate test/data

---

## Plan

### Root Cause Analysis

**Why this exists:**
- Traditional test pattern: "clean up after yourself"
- But for **evidence-based testing**, we want artifacts to persist
- test/data is NOT production - it's a sandbox for inspection
- Each test run should start fresh but LEAVE evidence

**Impact:**
- ❌ Cannot inspect test results manually
- ❌ Cannot verify generated file structure
- ❌ Cannot debug test failures (evidence deleted)
- ✅ But: Test isolation DOES work (just removes evidence)

**Correct Pattern (Evidence-Based Testing):**

1. **beforeAll:** Clean slate (remove old evidence)
2. **Tests run:** Create components, verify structure
3. **Tests pass/fail:** Results visible in test/data
4. **afterAll:** DO NOTHING (keep evidence)
5. **Developer:** Can cd to test/data and inspect/run commands
6. **Next run:** beforeAll cleans old evidence, creates new

### Goals

1. ✅ **Change cleanup timing:**
   - Move cleanup from afterAll to beforeAll
   - Remove afterAll hook entirely

2. ✅ **Add .gitignore for test/data:**
   - Ignore components/ subdirectory
   - Ignore scripts/ subdirectory
   - Keep .gitignore itself in git

3. ✅ **Document the pattern:**
   - Add comment explaining evidence persistence
   - Reference this PDCA in test file

4. ✅ **Verify evidence persists:**
   - Run tests
   - Verify test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent exists
   - Verify can cd into it and inspect

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] afterAll() hook removed from test
- [ ] beforeAll() cleans test/data/components
- [ ] Tests create components in test/data
- [ ] After tests run, evidence remains in test/data
- [ ] test/data/.gitignore created (ignores components/)
- [ ] All 51 tests still pass
- [ ] Can manually inspect test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/

### Migration Execution Plan

**Phase 1: Add .gitignore for test/data**

```bash
# Create .gitignore to keep test evidence out of git
cat > test/data/.gitignore << 'EOF'
# Test Evidence - Generated by tests, not committed to git
# test/data is a testable alternate isolated project root
# Evidence persists after tests for manual inspection
# Cleaned before each test run (beforeAll hook)

# Ignore generated components
components/

# Ignore generated scripts
scripts/

# Keep this .gitignore in git
!.gitignore
EOF
```

**Phase 2: Move Cleanup from afterAll to beforeAll**

**BEFORE (WRONG):**
```typescript
// test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:26-40

beforeAll(async () => {
  // Ensure test/data directory exists
  if (!existsSync(testDataDir)) {
    await mkdir(testDataDir, { recursive: true });
  }
});

afterAll(async () => {
  // ❌ WRONG: Cleanup removes evidence
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components', testComponentName);
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned up: ${testComponentName}`);
  }
});
```

**AFTER (CORRECT):**
```typescript
// test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:26-40

/**
 * Evidence-Based Testing Pattern (2025-10-30-UTC-0832.test-evidence-persistence.pdca.md):
 * 
 * - beforeAll: Clean OLD evidence (fresh start)
 * - Tests run: Create components in test/data
 * - afterAll: DO NOTHING (keep evidence for inspection)
 * - Next run: beforeAll cleans again
 * 
 * test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root.
 * After tests run, you can cd into test/data and inspect/test manually.
 */
beforeAll(async () => {
  // Clean old evidence before tests (fresh start)
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components');
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned old evidence: test/data/components/`);
  }
  
  // Ensure test/data directory exists
  if (!existsSync(testDataDir)) {
    await mkdir(testDataDir, { recursive: true });
  }
});

// ✅ NO afterAll - evidence persists for inspection
```

**Phase 3: Update Comment in First Test**

```typescript
it('should create component in test/data using targetDirectory', async () => {
  // Import dynamically to avoid module-level import issues
  const { DefaultWeb4TSComponent } = await import('../../src/ts/layer2/DefaultWeb4TSComponent.js');
  
  // ✅ Test Isolation Pattern (2025-10-30-UTC-0832.test-evidence-persistence.pdca.md):
  // Component uses setTargetDirectory() to create in test/data
  // Evidence persists after test for manual inspection
  // test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root
  
  // Create component instance
  const component = new DefaultWeb4TSComponent().init();
  
  // Set target directory to test/data for test isolation
  component.setTargetDirectory(testDataDir);
  
  // Create component in test isolation
  await component.create(testComponentName, testVersion, 'all');
  
  // Verify: Component created in test/data/components/, not in production components/
  expect(existsSync(testComponentPath)).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(path.join(testComponentPath, 'package.json'))).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(path.join(testComponentPath, 'src/ts'))).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(path.join(testComponentPath, 'src/sh'))).toBe(true);
  
  console.log(`   ✅ Component created in test isolation: ${testComponentPath}`);
  console.log(`   📂 Evidence persists at: ${testDataDir}`);
});
```

**Phase 4: Run Tests and Verify Evidence**

```bash
# Run tests
npm test

# Verify evidence remains
ls -la test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/
ls -la test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0/

# Can cd into evidence and inspect
cd test/data
ls -la
ls -la components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0/src/

# Evidence is a real component that could be tested
cd components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0
cat package.json
```

**Phase 5: Git Commit**

```bash
git add test/data/.gitignore
git add test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts
git add session/2025-10-30-UTC-0832.test-evidence-persistence.pdca.md
git pull --no-edit
git commit -m "2025-10-30-UTC-0832.test-evidence-persistence.pdca.md"
git push
```

## Summary

### Problem Statement

User feedback: "see the folders in test/data, but the component artifacts are gone. the ruel is to clean before the next test run and let the test results - the evidence - in test/data without deleting it. test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root."

**Current Violation:**

```typescript
// ❌ WRONG: test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:33-40
afterAll(async () => {
  // Cleanup: Remove created test component
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components', testComponentName);
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });  // ❌ DELETES EVIDENCE!
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned up: ${testComponentName}`);
  }
});
```

**Correct Pattern:**
- ✅ **beforeAll:** Clean test/data (remove old evidence)
- ✅ **Test runs:** Create components in test/data
- ✅ **afterAll:** DO NOTHING - keep evidence for inspection
- ✅ **Next run:** beforeAll cleans again (fresh start)

**Key Principle:**
> test/data becomes a **testable alternate isolated project root** - it should contain EVIDENCE of what the tests created, allowing manual inspection and validation.

### Artifact Links

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts](test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts) - Has wrong cleanup (to fix)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Cerulean-Circle-GmbH/Web4Articles/blob/dev/03180/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/.gitignore) | [§/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/.gitignore](test/data/.gitignore) - To create (ignore evidence in git)

### QA Decisions

**Decision 1: When to clean test/data?**
- [x] a) beforeAll (clean before tests run) - CORRECT
- [ ] b) afterAll (clean after tests run) - WRONG (removes evidence)
- [ ] c) Never clean (accumulates cruft)

**Decision 2: Should test/data be in git?**
- [x] a) No - add .gitignore (local evidence only)
- [ ] b) Yes - commit evidence to git
- [ ] c) Only commit structure, not contents

**Decision 3: What to clean in beforeAll?**
- [x] a) Remove entire test/data/components directory (full reset)
- [ ] b) Remove only specific test component
- [ ] c) Remove and recreate test/data

## Plan

### Root Cause Analysis

**Why this exists:**
- Traditional test pattern: "clean up after yourself"
- But for **evidence-based testing**, we want artifacts to persist
- test/data is NOT production - it's a sandbox for inspection
- Each test run should start fresh but LEAVE evidence

**Impact:**
- ❌ Cannot inspect test results manually
- ❌ Cannot verify generated file structure
- ❌ Cannot debug test failures (evidence deleted)
- ✅ But: Test isolation DOES work (just removes evidence)

**Correct Pattern (Evidence-Based Testing):**

1. **beforeAll:** Clean slate (remove old evidence)
2. **Tests run:** Create components, verify structure
3. **Tests pass/fail:** Results visible in test/data
4. **afterAll:** DO NOTHING (keep evidence)
5. **Developer:** Can cd to test/data and inspect/run commands
6. **Next run:** beforeAll cleans old evidence, creates new

### Goals

1. ✅ **Change cleanup timing:**
   - Move cleanup from afterAll to beforeAll
   - Remove afterAll hook entirely

2. ✅ **Add .gitignore for test/data:**
   - Ignore components/ subdirectory
   - Ignore scripts/ subdirectory
   - Keep .gitignore itself in git

3. ✅ **Document the pattern:**
   - Add comment explaining evidence persistence
   - Reference this PDCA in test file

4. ✅ **Verify evidence persists:**
   - Run tests
   - Verify test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent exists
   - Verify can cd into it and inspect

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] afterAll() hook removed from test
- [ ] beforeAll() cleans test/data/components
- [ ] Tests create components in test/data
- [ ] After tests run, evidence remains in test/data
- [ ] test/data/.gitignore created (ignores components/)
- [ ] All 51 tests still pass
- [ ] Can manually inspect test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/

### Migration Execution Plan

**Phase 1: Add .gitignore for test/data**

```bash
# Create .gitignore to keep test evidence out of git
cat > test/data/.gitignore << 'EOF'
# Test Evidence - Generated by tests, not committed to git
# test/data is a testable alternate isolated project root
# Evidence persists after tests for manual inspection
# Cleaned before each test run (beforeAll hook)

# Ignore generated components
components/

# Ignore generated scripts
scripts/

# Keep this .gitignore in git
!.gitignore
EOF
```

**Phase 2: Move Cleanup from afterAll to beforeAll**

**BEFORE (WRONG):**
```typescript
// test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:26-40

beforeAll(async () => {
  // Ensure test/data directory exists
  if (!existsSync(testDataDir)) {
    await mkdir(testDataDir, { recursive: true });
  }
});

afterAll(async () => {
  // ❌ WRONG: Cleanup removes evidence
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components', testComponentName);
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned up: ${testComponentName}`);
  }
});
```

**AFTER (CORRECT):**
```typescript
// test/vitest/component-creation-isolation.test.ts:26-40

/**
 * Evidence-Based Testing Pattern (2025-10-30-UTC-0832.test-evidence-persistence.pdca.md):
 * 
 * - beforeAll: Clean OLD evidence (fresh start)
 * - Tests run: Create components in test/data
 * - afterAll: DO NOTHING (keep evidence for inspection)
 * - Next run: beforeAll cleans again
 * 
 * test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root.
 * After tests run, you can cd into test/data and inspect/test manually.
 */
beforeAll(async () => {
  // Clean old evidence before tests (fresh start)
  const testComponentsDir = path.join(testDataDir, 'components');
  if (existsSync(testComponentsDir)) {
    await rm(testComponentsDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    console.log(`   🧹 Cleaned old evidence: test/data/components/`);
  }
  
  // Ensure test/data directory exists
  if (!existsSync(testDataDir)) {
    await mkdir(testDataDir, { recursive: true });
  }
});

// ✅ NO afterAll - evidence persists for inspection
```

**Phase 3: Update Comment in First Test**

```typescript
it('should create component in test/data using targetDirectory', async () => {
  // Import dynamically to avoid module-level import issues
  const { DefaultWeb4TSComponent } = await import('../../src/ts/layer2/DefaultWeb4TSComponent.js');
  
  // ✅ Test Isolation Pattern (2025-10-30-UTC-0832.test-evidence-persistence.pdca.md):
  // Component uses setTargetDirectory() to create in test/data
  // Evidence persists after test for manual inspection
  // test/data becomes a testable alternate isolated project root
  
  // Create component instance
  const component = new DefaultWeb4TSComponent().init();
  
  // Set target directory to test/data for test isolation
  component.setTargetDirectory(testDataDir);
  
  // Create component in test isolation
  await component.create(testComponentName, testVersion, 'all');
  
  // Verify: Component created in test/data/components/, not in production components/
  expect(existsSync(testComponentPath)).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(path.join(testComponentPath, 'package.json'))).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(path.join(testComponentPath, 'src/ts'))).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(path.join(testComponentPath, 'src/sh'))).toBe(true);
  
  console.log(`   ✅ Component created in test isolation: ${testComponentPath}`);
  console.log(`   📂 Evidence persists at: ${testDataDir}`);
});
```

## **🔧 DO**

### **Phase 1: Impact Analysis - Current State vs Required State**

**Current Violation Analysis:**

**Problem 1: `getTestDir()` Uses Non-Existent Method**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (DefaultCLI.ts:401-422):
protected getTestDir(): string {
  const web4ts = this.getWeb4TS();
  const context = web4ts.getComponentContext();  // ❌ Method doesn't exist!
  
  if (context) {
    return join(
      web4ts.resolveComponentPath(context.component, context.version),  // ❌ Doubles path!
      "test"
    );
  }
  
  // Check if we're in test isolation environment (test/data directory)
  const cwd = process.cwd();  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
  if (cwd.includes("/test/data")) {
    return join(cwd, "test");
  }
  
  // Fallback to current working directory
  return join(cwd, "test");  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
}
```

**Violations:**
1. ❌ Calls `getComponentContext()` which doesn't exist
2. ❌ Uses `resolveComponentPath()` which doubles the path (adds `targetDirectory + 'components/'` when already in component)
3. ❌ Uses `process.cwd()` directly - violates "DefaultCLI is Path Authority" principle
4. ❌ CLI should use `this.model` to store path information, not calculate from cwd

**Problem 2: CLIModel Missing Path Context**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (CLIModel.interface.ts:14-57):
export interface CLIModel extends Model {
  component?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;
  user?: User;
  
  // Completion context fields...
  completionCliName: string;
  completionCompWords: string[];
  // ... more completion fields
  
  // ❌ MISSING: No path context fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No component/version detection fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No test isolation state!
}
```

**Required Fields:**
- `componentName: string` - Detected component name
- `componentVersion: string` - Detected component version  
- `componentPath: string` - Full path to component directory
- `projectRoot: string` - Project root (prod or test/data)
- `testDirectory: string` - Path to test directory
- `isTestIsolation: boolean` - Running in test/data or production

**Problem 3: Path Calculation Scattered Across Methods**

Current locations calculating paths:
- `getTestDir()` in DefaultCLI - uses cwd ❌
- `resolveComponentPath()` in DefaultWeb4TSComponent - uses `this.model.targetDirectory` ✅
- `init()` - should detect and set all path context ❌ (currently doesn't)

**Correct Pattern (Path Authority Principle):**

```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT: DefaultCLI.init() detects ALL paths ONCE
init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  // 1. Detect project root (from cwd, considering test isolation)
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  const isTestIsolation = cwd.includes('/test/data');
  const projectRoot = this.detectProjectRootInternal(cwd, isTestIsolation);
  
  // 2. Detect component context (name, version, path)
  const componentContext = this.detectComponentContextInternal(cwd);
  
  // 3. Store ALL paths in this.model
  this.model = {
    ...defaultModel,
    projectRoot,
    componentName: componentContext.name,
    componentVersion: componentContext.version,
    componentPath: componentContext.path,
    testDirectory: join(componentContext.path, 'test'),
    isTestIsolation,
    // ... completion fields
  };
  
  // 4. Tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent where to operate
  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

// ✅ CORRECT: getTestDir() uses stored model
protected getTestDir(): string {
  return this.model.testDirectory;  // Simple! No calculation!
}
```

**Separation of Concerns:**

| Responsibility | Owner | Storage | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Path Detection** | DefaultCLI.init() | Calculate ONCE | Store in `this.model` |
| **Path Storage** | CLIModel | All path fields | Read-only access |
| **Path Usage** | All CLI methods | Read from `this.model` | NO recalculation |
| **Component Operation** | DefaultWeb4TSComponent | `this.model.targetDirectory` | Set by CLI |

describe('🧪 DefaultCLI - Path Authority (Production Scenario)', () => {
  let cli: Web4TSComponentCLI;
  let originalCwd: string;
  const componentRoot = path.join(__dirname, '../..');
  
  beforeEach(() => {

    // Change to component root (simulate production: web4tscomponent test file)

    // Create CLI instance with proper initialization
    cli = new Web4TSComponentCLI();
    cli.init();

  afterEach(() => {
    // Restore original cwd
    process.chdir(originalCwd);
  });

  it('should detect projectRoot correctly in production', () => {
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // In production, project root should be the main Web4Articles directory
    expect(model.projectRoot).toBe(path.join(componentRoot, '../../../'));
    expect(model.projectRoot).toContain('Web4Articles');
    expect(model.projectRoot).not.toContain('/test/data');
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Production projectRoot: ${model.projectRoot}`);
  });

  it('should detect component context correctly in production', () => {
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // Should detect Web4TSComponent and version
    expect(model.componentName).toBe('Web4TSComponent');
    expect(model.componentVersion).toMatch(/^0\.3\.\d+\.\d+$/);
    expect(model.componentPath).toBe(componentRoot);
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Component: ${model.componentName} ${model.componentVersion}`);
    console.log(`   ✅ Component path: ${model.componentPath}`);
  });

  it('should calculate test directory correctly in production', () => {
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // Test directory should be component/test
    expect(model.testDirectory).toBe(path.join(componentRoot, 'test'));
    
    // Verify: Path should NOT be doubled
    expect(model.testDirectory).not.toContain('/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1');
    
    // Verify test directory exists
    expect(fs.existsSync(model.testDirectory)).toBe(true);
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Test directory: ${model.testDirectory}`);
  });

  it('should mark isTestIsolation as false in production', () => {
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    expect(model.isTestIsolation).toBe(false);
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Test isolation: ${model.isTestIsolation}`);
  });

  it('should provide test directory via getTestDir() without recalculation', () => {
    // getTestDir() should simply return stored value
    const testDir = (cli as any).getTestDir();
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // Should return the same value stored in model
    expect(testDir).toBe(model.testDirectory);
    expect(testDir).toBe(path.join(componentRoot, 'test'));
    
    console.log(`   ✅ getTestDir() returns stored value: ${testDir}`);
  });

  it('should tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent the correct project root', () => {
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // CLI should set targetDirectory on component
    if (model.component) {
      const componentModel = model.component.model;
      expect(componentModel.targetDirectory).toBe(model.projectRoot);
      
      console.log(`   ✅ Component targetDirectory set: ${componentModel.targetDirectory}`);
    }
  });
});

describe('🧪 DefaultCLI - Path Authority (Test Isolation Scenario)', () => {

  });

    expect(model.projectRoot).toContain('/test/data');
    expect(model.projectRoot).not.toContain('/test/data/components');
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Test isolation projectRoot: ${model.projectRoot}`);

    console.log(`   ✅ Component path: ${model.componentPath}`);
  });

    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // Test directory should be test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0/test

    // Verify: Path should NOT be doubled
    expect(model.testDirectory).not.toContain('/test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0/components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0');
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Test directory: ${model.testDirectory}`);
  });

  it('should mark isTestIsolation as true in test isolation', () => {
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    expect(model.isTestIsolation).toBe(true);
    
    console.log(`   ✅ Test isolation: ${model.isTestIsolation}`);
  });

  it('should provide same test directory via getTestDir() without recalculation', () => {
    // getTestDir() should simply return stored value

    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    // Should return the same value stored in model
    expect(testDir).toBe(model.testDirectory);
    expect(testDir).toBe(path.join(testComponentPath, 'test'));

  it('should tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent the correct test/data project root', () => {

      expect(componentModel.targetDirectory).toBe(model.projectRoot);
      expect(componentModel.targetDirectory).toBe(testIsolationRoot);
      
      console.log(`   ✅ Component targetDirectory set: ${componentModel.targetDirectory}`);
    }
  });

  it('should handle SAME component operations in both scenarios identically', () => {
    // This test verifies the key principle:
    // DefaultWeb4TSComponent is UNAWARE of test vs prod
    // It just operates on whatever targetDirectory the CLI sets
    
    const model = (cli as any).model;
    
    if (model.component) {
      // Component should have targetDirectory set
      expect(model.component.model.targetDirectory).toBeDefined();
      
      // Component's resolveComponentPath should use targetDirectory
      // In test isolation: test/data
      // In production: project root

      expect(componentTargetDir).toBe(model.projectRoot);
      
      console.log(`   ✅ Component operates on CLI-provided path: ${componentTargetDir}`);
    }
  });
});

## **🔧 DO**

### **Phase 1: Impact Analysis - Current State vs Required State**

**CRITICAL CORRECTION After Reading Complete Architecture:**

After reading [[2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md]] COMPLETELY, I now understand:

1. ✅ **"on" Context = INSTANCE**: `this.model.context` stores a DefaultWeb4TSComponent INSTANCE (not data!)
2. ✅ **Path Authority**: DefaultCLI is sole path calculator, uses `this.model.component` INSTANCE  
3. ✅ **Component Unaware**: DefaultWeb4TSComponent only knows relative paths within component directory
4. ✅ **`completionOnComponent`**: This is bash completion state, NOT the "on" context instance!
5. ✅ **Delegation Pattern**: CLI delegates to `this.model.component` (the Web4TSComponent INSTANCE)

**Current Violation Analysis:**

**Problem 1: `getTestDir()` Uses Non-Existent Method**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (DefaultCLI.ts:401-422):
protected getTestDir(): string {
  const web4ts = this.getWeb4TS();
  const context = web4ts.getComponentContext();  // ❌ Method doesn't exist!
  
  if (context) {
    return join(
      web4ts.resolveComponentPath(context.component, context.version),  // ❌ Doubles path!
      "test"
    );
  }
  
  // Check if we're in test isolation environment (test/data directory)
  const cwd = process.cwd();  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
  if (cwd.includes("/test/data")) {
    return join(cwd, "test");
  }
  
  // Fallback to current working directory
  return join(cwd, "test");  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
}
```

**Violations:**
1. ❌ Calls `getComponentContext()` which doesn't exist
2. ❌ Uses `resolveComponentPath()` which doubles the path (adds `targetDirectory + 'components/'` when already in component)
3. ❌ Uses `process.cwd()` directly - violates "DefaultCLI is Path Authority" principle
4. ❌ CLI should use `this.model` to store path information, not calculate from cwd

**Problem 2: CLIModel Missing Path Context**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (CLIModel.interface.ts:14-57):
export interface CLIModel extends Model {
  component?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;
  user?: User;
  
  // Completion context fields...
  completionCliName: string;
  completionCompWords: string[];
  // ... more completion fields
  
  // ❌ MISSING: No path context fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No component/version detection fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No test isolation state!
}
```

**Required Fields:**
- `componentName: string` - Detected component name
- `componentVersion: string` - Detected component version  
- `componentPath: string` - Full path to component directory
- `projectRoot: string` - Project root (prod or test/data)
- `testDirectory: string` - Path to test directory
- `isTestIsolation: boolean` - Running in test/data or production

**Problem 3: Path Calculation Scattered Across Methods**

Current locations calculating paths:
- `getTestDir()` in DefaultCLI - uses cwd ❌
- `resolveComponentPath()` in DefaultWeb4TSComponent - uses `this.model.targetDirectory` ✅
- `init()` - should detect and set all path context ❌ (currently doesn't)

**Correct Pattern (Path Authority Principle):**

```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT: DefaultCLI.init() detects ALL paths ONCE
init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  // 1. Detect project root (from cwd, considering test isolation)
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  const isTestIsolation = cwd.includes('/test/data');
  const projectRoot = this.detectProjectRootInternal(cwd, isTestIsolation);
  
  // 2. Detect component context (name, version, path)
  const componentContext = this.detectComponentContextInternal(cwd);
  
  // 3. Store ALL paths in this.model
  this.model = {
    ...defaultModel,
    projectRoot,
    componentName: componentContext.name,
    componentVersion: componentContext.version,
    componentPath: componentContext.path,
    testDirectory: join(componentContext.path, 'test'),
    isTestIsolation,
    // ... completion fields
  };
  
  // 4. Tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent where to operate
  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

// ✅ CORRECT: getTestDir() uses stored model
protected getTestDir(): string {
  return this.model.testDirectory;  // Simple! No calculation!
}
```

**Separation of Concerns:**

| Responsibility | Owner | Storage | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Path Detection** | DefaultCLI.init() | Calculate ONCE | Store in `this.model` |
| **Path Storage** | CLIModel | All path fields | Read-only access |
| **Path Usage** | All CLI methods | Read from `this.model` | NO recalculation |
| **Component Operation** | DefaultWeb4TSComponent | `this.model.targetDirectory` | Set by CLI |

**Test Isolation Scenarios:**

**Scenario 1: Production (`web4tscomponent test file`)**
```
CWD: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1
Expected:
  projectRoot: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles
  componentPath: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1
  testDirectory: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test
  isTestIsolation: false
```

**Scenario 2: Test Isolation (`testisolatedcomponent test file`)**
```

Expected:
  projectRoot: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data
  componentPath: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0
  testDirectory: /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test/data/components/TestIsolatedComponent/0.1.0.0/test
  isTestIsolation: true
```

**Impact Summary:**

**Files to Change:**
1. ✅ `CLIModel.interface.ts` - Add path context fields
2. ✅ `DefaultCLI.ts` - Implement path detection in init(), simplify getTestDir()
3. ✅ `DefaultCLI.test-directory-path.test.ts` - Update test expectations

**Methods to Add:**
1. ✅ `detectProjectRootInternal(cwd, isTestIsolation): string` - Find project root
2. ✅ `detectComponentContextInternal(cwd): {name, version, path}` - Parse component from cwd

**Methods to Simplify:**
1. ✅ `getTestDir()` - Return `this.model.testDirectory` (1 line!)
2. ✅ `init()` - Detect and store ALL paths ONCE

**Methods to Delete:**
1. ❌ `getComponentContext()` usage - doesn't exist, not needed

**Principle Compliance:**

| Principle | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| **Path Authority** | ❌ Scattered (cwd in multiple places) | ✅ Centralized in init() |
| **Radical OOP** | ❌ Procedural (calculate each time) | ✅ State-based (store once, read many) |
| **Radical DRY** | ❌ Path logic duplicated | ✅ Calculated once in init() |
| **Component Unaware** | ❌ Component knows test vs prod | ✅ CLI sets targetDirectory |
| **Test Isolation** | ❌ Broken (path doubled) | ✅ Works (correct path detection) |

**CRITICAL CORRECTION After Reading Complete Architecture:**

After reading [[2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md]] COMPLETELY, I now understand:

1. ✅ **"on" Context = INSTANCE**: `this.model.context` stores a DefaultWeb4TSComponent INSTANCE (not data!)
2. ✅ **Path Authority**: DefaultCLI is sole path calculator, uses `this.model.component` INSTANCE  
3. ✅ **Component Unaware**: DefaultWeb4TSComponent only knows relative paths within component directory
4. ✅ **`completionOnComponent`**: This is bash completion state, NOT the "on" context instance!
5. ✅ **Delegation Pattern**: CLI delegates to `this.model.component` (the Web4TSComponent INSTANCE)

**Current Violation Analysis:**

**Problem 1: `getTestDir()` Uses Non-Existent Method**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (DefaultCLI.ts:401-422):
protected getTestDir(): string {
  const web4ts = this.getWeb4TS();
  const context = web4ts.getComponentContext();  // ❌ Method doesn't exist!

**Violations:**
1. ❌ Calls `getComponentContext()` which doesn't exist
2. ❌ Uses `resolveComponentPath()` which doubles the path (adds `targetDirectory + 'components/'` when already in component)
3. ❌ Uses `process.cwd()` directly - violates "DefaultCLI is Path Authority" principle

**Problem 2: CLIModel Missing Path Context**

```typescript

**Required Fields:**

- `componentVersion: string` - Detected component version  
- `componentPath: string` - Full path to component directory
- `projectRoot: string` - Project root (prod or test/data)
- `testDirectory: string` - Path to test directory
- `isTestIsolation: boolean` - Running in test/data or production

**Problem 3: Path Calculation Scattered Across Methods**

Current locations calculating paths:
- `getTestDir()` in DefaultCLI - uses cwd ❌
- `resolveComponentPath()` in DefaultWeb4TSComponent - uses `this.model.targetDirectory` ✅
- `init()` - should detect and set all path context ❌ (currently doesn't)

**Correct Pattern (Path Authority Principle):**

```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT: DefaultCLI.init() detects ALL paths ONCE
init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  // 1. Detect project root (from cwd, considering test isolation)
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  const isTestIsolation = cwd.includes('/test/data');
  const projectRoot = this.detectProjectRootInternal(cwd, isTestIsolation);
  
  // 2. Detect component context (name, version, path)
  const componentContext = this.detectComponentContextInternal(cwd);
  
  // 3. Store ALL paths in this.model
  this.model = {
    ...defaultModel,
    projectRoot,
    componentName: componentContext.name,
    componentVersion: componentContext.version,
    componentPath: componentContext.path,
    testDirectory: join(componentContext.path, 'test'),
    isTestIsolation,
    // ... completion fields
  };
  
  // 4. Tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent where to operate
  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

// ✅ CORRECT: getTestDir() uses stored model
protected getTestDir(): string {
  return this.model.testDirectory;  // Simple! No calculation!
}
```

**Separation of Concerns:**

| Responsibility | Owner | Storage | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Path Detection** | DefaultCLI.init() | Calculate ONCE | Store in `this.model` |
| **Path Storage** | CLIModel | All path fields | Read-only access |
| **Path Usage** | All CLI methods | Read from `this.model` | NO recalculation |
| **Component Operation** | DefaultWeb4TSComponent | `this.model.targetDirectory` | Set by CLI |

### **Step 3: Implement calculateProjectRoot() in DefaultCLI**

**File:** `src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Add Method (Private, @cliHide):**
```typescript
/**
 * Calculate project root - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all path calculations
 * Detects test isolation (test/data) vs production
 * 
 * Priority:
 * 1. WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
 * 2. Git repository root (git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
 * 3. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
 * 4. Test isolation: If cwd contains /test/data, use test/data as root
 * 
 * @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Path Authority implementation
 * @pdca 2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md:244-271 - Original design
 * @cliHide
 * @returns Absolute path to project root
 */
private calculateProjectRootInternal(): string {
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  
  // 1. Check for test isolation FIRST (highest priority for test context)
  if (cwd.includes('/test/data')) {
    // Find test/data directory by walking up from cwd
    const parts = cwd.split('/');
    const testDataIndex = parts.indexOf('test');
    if (testDataIndex !== -1 && parts[testDataIndex + 1] === 'data') {
      // Return path UP TO AND INCLUDING test/data
      return parts.slice(0, testDataIndex + 2).join('/');
    }
  }
  
  // 2. Try WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
  if (process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT) {
    return process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT;
  }
  
  // 3. Try git root
  try {
    const { execSync } = require('child_process');
    const gitRoot = execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel', { 
      encoding: 'utf8',
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore']  // Suppress stderr
    }).trim();
    if (existsSync(gitRoot)) {
      return gitRoot;
    }
  } catch {
    // Git not available or not in git repo - continue to next method
  }
  
  // 4. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
  let current = cwd;
  const root = '/';
  
  while (current !== root) {
    const packageJsonPath = join(current, 'package.json');
    if (existsSync(packageJsonPath)) {
      try {
        const content = readFileSync(packageJsonPath, 'utf-8');
        const pkg = JSON.parse(content);
        
        // Check for Web4 markers
        if (pkg.name?.includes('web4') || 
            pkg.dependencies?.['@web4x/web4tscomponent'] ||
            existsSync(join(current, 'components'))) {
          return current;
        }
      } catch {
        // Invalid JSON, continue searching
      }
    }
    
    // Move up one directory
    const parent = join(current, '..');
    if (parent === current) break;  // Reached root
    current = parent;
  }
  
  // 5. Fallback: Use cwd
  return cwd;
}
```

init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {

    // ✅ Path Authority: Calculate ALL paths ONCE and store in model
    // @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Implementing Path Authority

      completionCommand: null,

  }

}

### **Phase 1: Impact Analysis - Current State vs Required State**

**CRITICAL CORRECTION After Reading Complete Architecture:**

After reading [[2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md]] COMPLETELY, I now understand:

1. ✅ **"on" Context = INSTANCE**: `this.model.context` stores a DefaultWeb4TSComponent INSTANCE (not data!)
2. ✅ **Path Authority**: DefaultCLI is sole path calculator, uses `this.model.component` INSTANCE  
3. ✅ **Component Unaware**: DefaultWeb4TSComponent only knows relative paths within component directory
4. ✅ **`completionOnComponent`**: This is bash completion state, NOT the "on" context instance!
5. ✅ **Delegation Pattern**: CLI delegates to `this.model.component` (the Web4TSComponent INSTANCE)

**Current Violation Analysis:**

**Problem 1: `getTestDir()` Uses Non-Existent Method**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (DefaultCLI.ts:401-422):
protected getTestDir(): string {
  const web4ts = this.getWeb4TS();
  const context = web4ts.getComponentContext();  // ❌ Method doesn't exist!
  
  if (context) {
    return join(
      web4ts.resolveComponentPath(context.component, context.version),  // ❌ Doubles path!
      "test"
    );
  }
  
  // Check if we're in test isolation environment (test/data directory)
  const cwd = process.cwd();  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
  if (cwd.includes("/test/data")) {
    return join(cwd, "test");
  }
  
  // Fallback to current working directory
  return join(cwd, "test");  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
}
```

**Violations:**
1. ❌ Calls `getComponentContext()` which doesn't exist
2. ❌ Uses `resolveComponentPath()` which doubles the path (adds `targetDirectory + 'components/'` when already in component)
3. ❌ Uses `process.cwd()` directly - violates "DefaultCLI is Path Authority" principle
4. ❌ CLI should use `this.model` to store path information, not calculate from cwd

**Problem 2: CLIModel Missing Path Context**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (CLIModel.interface.ts:14-57):
export interface CLIModel extends Model {
  component?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;
  user?: User;
  
  // Completion context fields...
  completionCliName: string;
  completionCompWords: string[];
  // ... more completion fields
  
  // ❌ MISSING: No path context fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No component/version detection fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No test isolation state!
}
```

**Required Fields:**
- `componentName: string` - Detected component name
- `componentVersion: string` - Detected component version  
- `componentPath: string` - Full path to component directory
- `projectRoot: string` - Project root (prod or test/data)
- `testDirectory: string` - Path to test directory
- `isTestIsolation: boolean` - Running in test/data or production

**Problem 3: Path Calculation Scattered Across Methods**

Current locations calculating paths:
- `getTestDir()` in DefaultCLI - uses cwd ❌
- `resolveComponentPath()` in DefaultWeb4TSComponent - uses `this.model.targetDirectory` ✅
- `init()` - should detect and set all path context ❌ (currently doesn't)

**Correct Pattern (Path Authority Principle):**

```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT: DefaultCLI.init() detects ALL paths ONCE
init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  // 1. Detect project root (from cwd, considering test isolation)
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  const isTestIsolation = cwd.includes('/test/data');
  const projectRoot = this.detectProjectRootInternal(cwd, isTestIsolation);
  
  // 2. Detect component context (name, version, path)
  const componentContext = this.detectComponentContextInternal(cwd);
  
  // 3. Store ALL paths in this.model
  this.model = {
    ...defaultModel,
    projectRoot,
    componentName: componentContext.name,
    componentVersion: componentContext.version,
    componentPath: componentContext.path,
    testDirectory: join(componentContext.path, 'test'),
    isTestIsolation,
    // ... completion fields
  };
  
  // 4. Tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent where to operate
  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

// ✅ CORRECT: getTestDir() uses stored model
protected getTestDir(): string {
  return this.model.testDirectory;  // Simple! No calculation!
}
```

**Separation of Concerns:**

| Responsibility | Owner | Storage | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Path Detection** | DefaultCLI.init() | Calculate ONCE | Store in `this.model` |
| **Path Storage** | CLIModel | All path fields | Read-only access |
| **Path Usage** | All CLI methods | Read from `this.model` | NO recalculation |
| **Component Operation** | DefaultWeb4TSComponent | `this.model.targetDirectory` | Set by CLI |

### **Step 3: Implement calculateProjectRoot() in DefaultCLI**

**File:** `src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Why This File:** DefaultCLI is the base class for ALL CLIs. Implement ONCE, inherited by ALL!

**Add Method (Private, @cliHide):**
```typescript
/**
 * Calculate project root - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all path calculations
 * Detects test isolation (test/data) vs production
 * 
 * INHERITANCE: This method is inherited by:
 * - Web4TSComponentCLI (this component's CLI)
 * - TestIsolatedComponentCLI (generated test component)
 * - ALL future generated component CLIs
 * 
 * Priority:
 * 1. Test isolation FIRST: If cwd contains /test/data, use test/data as root
 * 2. WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
 * 3. Git repository root (git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
 * 4. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
 * 5. Fallback: cwd
 * 
 * @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Path Authority implementation
 * @pdca 2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md:244-271 - Original design
 * @cliHide
 * @returns Absolute path to project root
 */
private calculateProjectRootInternal(): string {
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  
  // 1. Check for test isolation FIRST (highest priority for test context)
  // CRITICAL: Works for both Web4TSComponent tests AND generated component tests
  if (cwd.includes('/test/data')) {
    // Find test/data directory by walking up from cwd
    const parts = cwd.split('/');
    const testDataIndex = parts.indexOf('test');
    if (testDataIndex !== -1 && parts[testDataIndex + 1] === 'data') {
      // Return path UP TO AND INCLUDING test/data
      return parts.slice(0, testDataIndex + 2).join('/');
    }
  }
  
  // 2. Try WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
  if (process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT) {
    return process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT;
  }
  
  // 3. Try git root
  try {
    const { execSync } = require('child_process');
    const gitRoot = execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel', { 
      encoding: 'utf8',
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore']  // Suppress stderr
    }).trim();
    if (existsSync(gitRoot)) {
      return gitRoot;
    }
  } catch {
    // Git not available or not in git repo - continue to next method
  }
  
  // 4. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
  let current = cwd;
  const root = '/';
  
  while (current !== root) {
    const packageJsonPath = join(current, 'package.json');
    if (existsSync(packageJsonPath)) {
      try {
        const content = readFileSync(packageJsonPath, 'utf-8');
        const pkg = JSON.parse(content);
        
        // Check for Web4 markers
        if (pkg.name?.includes('web4') || 
            pkg.dependencies?.['@web4x/web4tscomponent'] ||
            existsSync(join(current, 'components'))) {
          return current;
        }
      } catch {
        // Invalid JSON, continue searching
      }
    }
    
    // Move up one directory
    const parent = join(current, '..');
    if (parent === current) break;  // Reached root
    current = parent;
  }
  
  // 5. Fallback: Use cwd
  return cwd;
}
```

**Impact:**
- ✅ Web4TSComponentCLI calls this.calculateProjectRootInternal() in init()
- ✅ TestIsolatedComponentCLI calls this.calculateProjectRootInternal() in init() (inherited!)
- ✅ ALL generated CLIs automatically get test isolation detection
- ✅ ZERO code duplication - implemented ONCE in base class

**Test After Change:** Still fails (method exists but not called in init())

### **Step 3: Implement calculateProjectRoot() in DefaultCLI**

**File:** `src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Add Method (Private, @cliHide):**
```typescript
/**
 * Calculate project root - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all path calculations
 * Detects test isolation (test/data) vs production
 * 
 * Priority:
 * 1. WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
 * 2. Git repository root (git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
 * 3. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
 * 4. Test isolation: If cwd contains /test/data, use test/data as root
 * 
 * @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Path Authority implementation
 * @pdca 2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md:244-271 - Original design
 * @cliHide
 * @returns Absolute path to project root
 */
private calculateProjectRootInternal(): string {
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  
  // 1. Check for test isolation FIRST (highest priority for test context)
  if (cwd.includes('/test/data')) {
    // Find test/data directory by walking up from cwd
    const parts = cwd.split('/');
    const testDataIndex = parts.indexOf('test');
    if (testDataIndex !== -1 && parts[testDataIndex + 1] === 'data') {
      // Return path UP TO AND INCLUDING test/data
      return parts.slice(0, testDataIndex + 2).join('/');
    }
  }
  
  // 2. Try WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
  if (process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT) {
    return process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT;
  }
  
  // 3. Try git root
  try {
    const { execSync } = require('child_process');
    const gitRoot = execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel', { 
      encoding: 'utf8',
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore']  // Suppress stderr
    }).trim();
    if (existsSync(gitRoot)) {
      return gitRoot;
    }
  } catch {
    // Git not available or not in git repo - continue to next method
  }
  
  // 4. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
  let current = cwd;
  const root = '/';
  
  while (current !== root) {
    const packageJsonPath = join(current, 'package.json');
    if (existsSync(packageJsonPath)) {
      try {
        const content = readFileSync(packageJsonPath, 'utf-8');
        const pkg = JSON.parse(content);
        
        // Check for Web4 markers
        if (pkg.name?.includes('web4') || 
            pkg.dependencies?.['@web4x/web4tscomponent'] ||
            existsSync(join(current, 'components'))) {
          return current;
        }
      } catch {
        // Invalid JSON, continue searching
      }
    }
    
    // Move up one directory
    const parent = join(current, '..');
    if (parent === current) break;  // Reached root
    current = parent;
  }
  
  // 5. Fallback: Use cwd
  return cwd;
}
```

### **Phase 1: Impact Analysis - Current State vs Required State**

**CRITICAL CORRECTION After Reading Complete Architecture:**

After reading [[2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md]] COMPLETELY, I now understand:

1. ✅ **"on" Context = INSTANCE**: `this.model.context` stores a DefaultWeb4TSComponent INSTANCE (not data!)
2. ✅ **Path Authority**: DefaultCLI is sole path calculator, uses `this.model.component` INSTANCE  
3. ✅ **Component Unaware**: DefaultWeb4TSComponent only knows relative paths within component directory
4. ✅ **`completionOnComponent`**: This is bash completion state, NOT the "on" context instance!
5. ✅ **Delegation Pattern**: CLI delegates to `this.model.component` (the Web4TSComponent INSTANCE)

**Current Violation Analysis:**

**Problem 1: `getTestDir()` Uses Non-Existent Method**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (DefaultCLI.ts:401-422):
protected getTestDir(): string {
  const web4ts = this.getWeb4TS();
  const context = web4ts.getComponentContext();  // ❌ Method doesn't exist!
  
  if (context) {
    return join(
      web4ts.resolveComponentPath(context.component, context.version),  // ❌ Doubles path!
      "test"
    );
  }
  
  // Check if we're in test isolation environment (test/data directory)
  const cwd = process.cwd();  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
  if (cwd.includes("/test/data")) {
    return join(cwd, "test");
  }
  
  // Fallback to current working directory
  return join(cwd, "test");  // ❌ Violates path authority principle!
}
```

**Violations:**
1. ❌ Calls `getComponentContext()` which doesn't exist
2. ❌ Uses `resolveComponentPath()` which doubles the path (adds `targetDirectory + 'components/'` when already in component)
3. ❌ Uses `process.cwd()` directly - violates "DefaultCLI is Path Authority" principle
4. ❌ CLI should use `this.model` to store path information, not calculate from cwd

**Problem 2: CLIModel Missing Path Context**

```typescript
// ❌ CURRENT (CLIModel.interface.ts:14-57):
export interface CLIModel extends Model {
  component?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;
  user?: User;
  
  // Completion context fields...
  completionCliName: string;
  completionCompWords: string[];
  // ... more completion fields
  
  // ❌ MISSING: No path context fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No component/version detection fields!
  // ❌ MISSING: No test isolation state!
}
```

**Required Fields:**
- `componentName: string` - Detected component name
- `componentVersion: string` - Detected component version  
- `componentPath: string` - Full path to component directory
- `projectRoot: string` - Project root (prod or test/data)
- `testDirectory: string` - Path to test directory
- `isTestIsolation: boolean` - Running in test/data or production

**Problem 3: Path Calculation Scattered Across Methods**

Current locations calculating paths:
- `getTestDir()` in DefaultCLI - uses cwd ❌
- `resolveComponentPath()` in DefaultWeb4TSComponent - uses `this.model.targetDirectory` ✅
- `init()` - should detect and set all path context ❌ (currently doesn't)

**Correct Pattern (Path Authority Principle):**

```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT: DefaultCLI.init() detects ALL paths ONCE
init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  // 1. Detect project root (from cwd, considering test isolation)
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  const isTestIsolation = cwd.includes('/test/data');
  const projectRoot = this.detectProjectRootInternal(cwd, isTestIsolation);
  
  // 2. Detect component context (name, version, path)
  const componentContext = this.detectComponentContextInternal(cwd);
  
  // 3. Store ALL paths in this.model
  this.model = {
    ...defaultModel,
    projectRoot,
    componentName: componentContext.name,
    componentVersion: componentContext.version,
    componentPath: componentContext.path,
    testDirectory: join(componentContext.path, 'test'),
    isTestIsolation,
    // ... completion fields
  };
  
  // 4. Tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent where to operate
  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

// ✅ CORRECT: getTestDir() uses stored model
protected getTestDir(): string {
  return this.model.testDirectory;  // Simple! No calculation!
}
```

**Separation of Concerns:**

| Responsibility | Owner | Storage | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Path Detection** | DefaultCLI.init() | Calculate ONCE | Store in `this.model` |
| **Path Storage** | CLIModel | All path fields | Read-only access |
| **Path Usage** | All CLI methods | Read from `this.model` | NO recalculation |
| **Component Operation** | DefaultWeb4TSComponent | `this.model.targetDirectory` | Set by CLI |

### **Step 3: Implement calculateProjectRoot() in DefaultCLI**

**File:** `src/ts/layer2/DefaultCLI.ts`

**Why This File:** DefaultCLI is the base class for ALL CLIs. Implement ONCE, inherited by ALL!

**Add Method (Private, @cliHide):**
```typescript
/**
 * Calculate project root - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all path calculations
 * Detects test isolation (test/data) vs production
 * 
 * INHERITANCE: This method is inherited by:
 * - Web4TSComponentCLI (this component's CLI)
 * - TestIsolatedComponentCLI (generated test component)
 * - ALL future generated component CLIs
 * 
 * Priority:
 * 1. Test isolation FIRST: If cwd contains /test/data, use test/data as root
 * 2. WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
 * 3. Git repository root (git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
 * 4. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
 * 5. Fallback: cwd
 * 
 * @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Path Authority implementation
 * @pdca 2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md:244-271 - Original design
 * @cliHide
 * @returns Absolute path to project root
 */
private calculateProjectRootInternal(): string {
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  
  // 1. Check for test isolation FIRST (highest priority for test context)
  // CRITICAL: Works for both Web4TSComponent tests AND generated component tests
  if (cwd.includes('/test/data')) {
    // Find test/data directory by walking up from cwd
    const parts = cwd.split('/');
    const testDataIndex = parts.indexOf('test');
    if (testDataIndex !== -1 && parts[testDataIndex + 1] === 'data') {
      // Return path UP TO AND INCLUDING test/data
      return parts.slice(0, testDataIndex + 2).join('/');
    }
  }
  
  // 2. Try WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT environment variable
  if (process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT) {
    return process.env.WEB4_PROJECT_ROOT;
  }
  
  // 3. Try git root
  try {
    const { execSync } = require('child_process');
    const gitRoot = execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel', { 
      encoding: 'utf8',
      stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore']  // Suppress stderr
    }).trim();
    if (existsSync(gitRoot)) {
      return gitRoot;
    }
  } catch {
    // Git not available or not in git repo - continue to next method
  }
  
  // 4. Directory traversal looking for package.json with Web4 markers
  let current = cwd;
  const root = '/';
  
  while (current !== root) {
    const packageJsonPath = join(current, 'package.json');
    if (existsSync(packageJsonPath)) {
      try {
        const content = readFileSync(packageJsonPath, 'utf-8');
        const pkg = JSON.parse(content);
        
        // Check for Web4 markers
        if (pkg.name?.includes('web4') || 
            pkg.dependencies?.['@web4x/web4tscomponent'] ||
            existsSync(join(current, 'components'))) {
          return current;
        }
      } catch {
        // Invalid JSON, continue searching
      }
    }
    
    // Move up one directory
    const parent = join(current, '..');
    if (parent === current) break;  // Reached root
    current = parent;
  }
  
  // 5. Fallback: Use cwd
  return cwd;
}
```

**Impact:**
- ✅ Web4TSComponentCLI calls this.calculateProjectRootInternal() in init()
- ✅ TestIsolatedComponentCLI calls this.calculateProjectRootInternal() in init() (inherited!)
- ✅ ALL generated CLIs automatically get test isolation detection
- ✅ ZERO code duplication - implemented ONCE in base class

init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  if (!this.model) {
    // ✅ Path Authority: Calculate ALL paths ONCE and store in model
    // INHERITANCE: This runs for ALL CLIs (Web4TSComponent, TestIsolatedComponent, etc.)
    // @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Implementing Path Authority
    const projectRoot = this.calculateProjectRootInternal();

      scriptsVersionDir: join(projectRoot, 'scripts', 'versions'),

      completionParameters: [],
      completionParameterIndex: 0,
      completionOnComponent: null,
      completionOnVersion: null,
      completionChainedCommands: [],
      completionIsCompletingMethod: false,
      completionIsCompletingParameter: false,
    };
  }

  // ✅ Tell DefaultWeb4TSComponent where to operate (Path Authority → Component)

  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(this.model.projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

### **ARCHITECTURAL DECISION: "on()" Method Placement Analysis**

**🎯 Question from TRON:**
> "reflect if the 'on' method is better a method of DefaultCLI or better a method of DefaultWeb4TSComponent when it is to be reused in the generated component the same way. the generated component has the delegation pattern to web4tscomponent...so should the reused defaultCLI handle all context? completion, shell state, cursor positions, and component on which it operates and delegates to."
>
> "what if PDCA/latest in future will delegate pdca links to web4tscomponent class using the identical DefaultCLI as all other components."

**📊 Current Implementation Analysis:**

**Status Quo:**
- ✅ `on()` is currently in `DefaultWeb4TSComponent` (line 1628)
- ✅ Stores context in `this.model.context` (Web4TSComponentModel)
- ❌ `DefaultCLI` has `completionOnComponent` and `completionOnVersion` (CLIModel) for bash completion state ONLY
- ❌ Two separate "contexts": one for component delegation (`Web4TSComponentModel.context`), one for completion (`CLIModel.completionOn*`)
- ❌ Generated components (TestIsolatedComponent, PDCA) will use delegation pattern to Web4TSComponent

**Impact Analysis:**

**Option 1: Keep on() in DefaultWeb4TSComponent (Current)**
```typescript
// DefaultWeb4TSComponent.ts
async on(component: string, version: string): Promise<this> {
  const targetComponent = new DefaultWeb4TSComponent().init();
  targetComponent.model.version = SemanticVersion.fromString(actualVersion);
  targetComponent.model.component = component;
  targetComponent.model.origin = componentPath;
  targetComponent.model.projectRoot = componentPath;  // ❌ VIOLATES PATH AUTHORITY
  targetComponent.model.targetDirectory = componentPath;
  
  this.model.context = targetComponent;  // ✅ Store INSTANCE
  return this;
}

// Usage in Web4TSComponent:
web4tscomponent on PDCA 0.3.5.1 links
// ✅ Works: Web4TSComponent has on() method

// Usage in TestIsolatedComponent:
testisolatedcomponent on PDCA 0.3.5.1 links
// ✅ Works: TestIsolatedComponent delegates to Web4TSComponent which has on()

// Usage in PDCA component (future):
pdca on Unit 0.3.0.5 tree
// ❌ BREAKS: PDCA doesn't extend Web4TSComponent, it delegates to it
// ❌ PDCA would need to implement its own on() method
// ❌ Code duplication across all component types
```

**Violations:**
1. ❌ **DRY Violation:** Every component type (PDCA, Unit, TestIsolated) must implement on() separately
2. ❌ **Path Authority Violation:** `on()` sets `projectRoot` and `targetDirectory` directly (line 1646-1647)
3. ❌ **Separation Violation:** Component method handling CLI cross-component context
4. ❌ **Reusability Violation:** Not inherited by generated components that use delegation pattern

---

**Option 2: Move on() to DefaultCLI (RECOMMENDED)**
```typescript
// CLIModel.interface.ts
export interface CLIModel extends Model {
  // ✅ Path Authority fields
  projectRoot: string;
  componentsDir: string;
  scriptsDir: string;
  scriptsVersionDir: string;
  testDataDir: string;
  
  // ✅ Component instances (radical OOP)
  component?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;  // Primary component (Web4TSComponent, PDCA, Unit, etc.)
  user?: User;
  
  // ✅ UNIFIED CONTEXT: Single "on" context for ALL purposes
  context?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;  // Target component loaded via on()
  
  // Completion fields remain (bash completion state)
  completionOnComponent: string | null;  // ❌ REMOVE - redundant with context.model.component
  completionOnVersion: string | null;    // ❌ REMOVE - redundant with context.model.version
}

// DefaultCLI.ts
/**
 * Load component context for delegation (universal across ALL components)
 * Works for Web4TSComponent, PDCA, Unit, TestIsolatedComponent - ANY generated component!
 * 
 * @pdca 2025-10-30-UTC-0859.pdca.md - Moved from DefaultWeb4TSComponent to DefaultCLI
 * @pdca 2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md:3057 - Context INSTANCE pattern
 * @example web4tscomponent on PDCA 0.3.5.1 links
 * @example testisolatedcomponent on Unit 0.3.0.5 tree
 * @example pdca on Web4TSComponent 0.3.17.1 test
 */
async on(component: string, version: string = 'latest'): Promise<this> {
  // ✅ CLI calculates ALL paths (Path Authority)
  const actualVersion = this.resolveActualVersion(component, version);
  const componentPath = join(this.model.componentsDir, component, actualVersion);
  
  if (!existsSync(componentPath)) {
    throw new Error(`Component not found: ${component} ${version} at ${componentPath}`);
  }
  
  // ✅ Dynamically load target component class
  const targetComponent = await this.loadComponentInstance(component, actualVersion);
  
  // ✅ CLI tells component where to operate (Path Authority → Component)
  targetComponent.setTargetDirectory(componentPath);
  
  // ✅ Store INSTANCE in CLI context (not component context!)
  this.model.context = targetComponent;
  
  console.log(`✅ Component context loaded: ${component} ${actualVersion}`);
  console.log(`   Path: ${componentPath}`);
  
  return this;  // Enable chaining
}

/**
 * Dynamically load any component class (Web4TSComponent, PDCA, Unit, etc.)
 * @cliHide
 */
private async loadComponentInstance(componentName: string, version: string): Promise<DefaultWeb4TSComponent> {
  const componentPath = join(this.model.componentsDir, componentName, version);
  const modulePath = join(componentPath, 'src', 'ts', 'layer2', `Default${componentName}.js`);
  
  if (!existsSync(modulePath)) {
    throw new Error(`Component module not found: ${modulePath}`);
  }
  
  // ✅ Dynamic import (works for ANY component type!)
  const { [`Default${componentName}`]: ComponentClass } = await import(modulePath);
  const instance = new ComponentClass().init();
  
  return instance;
}

// Usage in Web4TSComponent:
web4tscomponent on PDCA 0.3.5.1 links
// ✅ Works: DefaultCLI.on() loads PDCA, delegates links to it

// Usage in TestIsolatedComponent:
testisolatedcomponent on Unit 0.3.0.5 tree
// ✅ Works: TestIsolatedComponentCLI extends DefaultCLI, inherits on()

// Usage in PDCA component (future):
pdca on Web4TSComponent 0.3.17.1 test
// ✅ Works: PDCACLI extends DefaultCLI, inherits on()
```

**Benefits:**
1. ✅ **DRY:** ALL components (Web4TSComponent, PDCA, Unit, TestIsolated) inherit on() from DefaultCLI
2. ✅ **Path Authority:** CLI calculates paths, component receives targetDirectory
3. ✅ **Separation:** CLI handles cross-component context, component handles its own operations
4. ✅ **Reusability:** Generated components automatically get on() through CLI inheritance
5. ✅ **Consistency:** Same on() behavior across ALL component types
6. ✅ **Unified Context:** Single `model.context` for completion AND delegation
7. ✅ **Future-Proof:** PDCA, Unit, and all future components work identically

**Delegation Pattern Verification:**

```typescript
// TestIsolatedComponentCLI extends DefaultCLI
class TestIsolatedComponentCLI extends DefaultCLI {
  constructor() {
    super();
    // ✅ Inherits on() from DefaultCLI
  }
}

// DefaultTestIsolatedComponent delegates to Web4TSComponent
class DefaultTestIsolatedComponent {
  private web4ts: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;
  
  async clean(): Promise<this> {
    await this.web4ts.clean();  // Delegation
    return this;
  }
  
  async build(): Promise<this> {
    await this.web4ts.build();  // Delegation
    return this;
  }
}

// Command execution flow:
// 1. User types: testisolatedcomponent on PDCA 0.3.5.1 links
// 2. TestIsolatedComponentCLI.execute() receives command
// 3. Finds on() method (inherited from DefaultCLI)
// 4. DefaultCLI.on() loads PDCA instance into this.model.context
// 5. TestIsolatedComponentCLI.execute() finds links command
// 6. Checks: typeof (this as any)['links'] → NO (CLI doesn't have links)
// 7. Checks: typeof (this.model.component as any)['links'] → YES (TestIsolatedComponent has it)
// 8. TestIsolatedComponent.links() delegates to this.web4ts.links()
// 9. BUT WAIT: We're in "on" context, so we should call this.model.context.links()!
```

**CRITICAL INSIGHT: Command Execution Priority**
```typescript
// Web4TSComponentCLI.executeDynamicCommandWithChaining()
const target = this.model.context || this.model.component;  // ✅ Context first!

// Execute method on target (context takes precedence)
if (typeof (this as any)[command] === 'function') {
  // CLI method (on, test, build, etc.)
  await (this as any)[command].apply(this, methodArgs);
} else if (this.model.context && typeof (this.model.context as any)[command] === 'function') {
  // ✅ Context method (via on()) - HIGHEST PRIORITY for component methods
  await (this.model.context as any)[command].apply(this.model.context, methodArgs);
} else if (this.model.component && typeof (this.model.component as any)[command] === 'function') {
  // Fallback to primary component
  await (this.model.component as any)[command].apply(this.model.component, methodArgs);
} else {
  throw new Error(`Method not found: ${command}`);
}
```

## **Key Findings:**

### **🎯 The "on()" Method Belongs in DefaultCLI**

**Current Problem:**
- ❌ `on()` is in `DefaultWeb4TSComponent` → **DRY violation** for generated components
- ❌ Sets `projectRoot` and `targetDirectory` directly → **Path Authority violation**
- ❌ Two separate contexts: `Web4TSComponentModel.context` + `CLIModel.completionOn*` → **Dual context confusion**
- ❌ Won't work for future PDCA/Unit components → **Not future-proof**

**Solution:**
```typescript
// DefaultCLI becomes the universal context manager for ALL components
async on(component: string, version: string = 'latest'): Promise<this> {
  // ✅ CLI calculates paths (Path Authority)
  const componentPath = join(this.model.componentsDir, component, actualVersion);
  
  // ✅ Dynamically loads ANY component (Web4TSComponent, PDCA, Unit, TestIsolated)
  const targetComponent = await this.loadComponentInstance(component, actualVersion);
  
  // ✅ CLI tells component where to operate
  targetComponent.setTargetDirectory(componentPath);
  
  // ✅ Store INSTANCE in CLI context
  this.model.context = targetComponent;
  
  return this;
}
```

### **💫 Benefits of Moving on() to DefaultCLI:**

1. ✅ **DRY:** ALL components inherit `on()` through CLI inheritance
2. ✅ **Path Authority:** CLI calculates ALL paths consistently
3. ✅ **Separation:** CLI handles cross-component context, component handles operations
4. ✅ **Reusability:** TestIsolatedComponent, PDCA, Unit ALL get `on()` for free
5. ✅ **Unified Context:** Single `model.context` for completion AND delegation
6. ✅ **Future-Proof:** Works identically for ALL current and future components

## **📋 PLAN**

**Objective:** Implement Path Authority architecture in DefaultCLI as the universal context manager for ALL components (Web4TSComponent, TestIsolatedComponent, PDCA, Unit, future components), fixing the production path doubling bug and establishing a DRY, future-proof foundation through inheritance.

**Requirements Traceability:**
- [2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md:207-285](2025-10-28-UTC-0934.pdca.md) - Original Path Authority design
- [2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md](2025-10-29-UTC-1323.path-separation-violation-fix.pdca.md) - Path separation baseline

**Problem Statement:**

**Production Bug:**
```bash
$ cd /Users/Shared/Workspaces/temp/Web4Articles/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1
$ web4tscomponent test file
❌ Test directory not found: .../Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/components/Web4TSComponent/0.3.17.1/test
# Path doubling: component path appears TWICE!
```

**Root Causes:**
1. **Path Authority Violation:** `DefaultWeb4TSComponent.on()` sets `projectRoot` and `targetDirectory` directly (lines 1646-1647), violating separation of concerns
2. **DRY Violation:** Every generated component (TestIsolatedComponent, PDCA, Unit) must implement on() separately, duplicating logic
3. **Dual Context Confusion:** Two separate contexts exist:
   - `Web4TSComponentModel.context` (component delegation)
   - `CLIModel.completionOnComponent/completionOnVersion` (bash completion state)
4. **Missing Path Authority:** Path calculation scattered across components instead of centralized in CLI
5. **getTestDir() Path Doubling:** Calls `resolveComponentPath()` which adds `components/` to a path that's already inside a component directory

**Impact Analysis:**

**Current State (BEFORE):**

```typescript
// CLIModel.interface.ts - Path Authority fields added
export interface CLIModel extends Model {
  // ✅ Path Authority - CLI's sole responsibility
  projectRoot: string;          // Calculated ONCE in init()
  componentsDir: string;        // projectRoot/components
  scriptsDir: string;           // projectRoot/scripts
  scriptsVersionDir: string;    // projectRoot/scripts/versions
  testDataDir: string;          // projectRoot/test/data
  
  // ✅ Component instances (radical OOP)
  component?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;
  user?: User;
  
  // ✅ UNIFIED CONTEXT - Single source of truth
  context?: DefaultWeb4TSComponent;  // Target component from on()
  
  // ✅ Completion fields (bash state only - NO component info!)
  completionCliName: string;
  completionCompWords: string[];
  // ... other completion fields
  
  // ❌ REMOVED: completionOnComponent, completionOnVersion
}

// DefaultCLI.ts - Path Authority implementation
init(scenario?: Scenario<CLIModel>): this {
  if (!this.model) {
    // ✅ Calculate ALL paths ONCE (Path Authority)
    const projectRoot = this.calculateProjectRootInternal();
    
    this.model = {
      uuid: crypto.randomUUID(),
      projectRoot: projectRoot,
      componentsDir: join(projectRoot, 'components'),
      scriptsDir: join(projectRoot, 'scripts'),
      scriptsVersionDir: join(projectRoot, 'scripts', 'versions'),
      testDataDir: join(projectRoot, 'test', 'data'),
      // ... completion fields
    };
  }
  
  // ✅ Tell component where to operate (Path Authority → Component)
  if (this.model.component) {
    this.model.component.setTargetDirectory(this.model.projectRoot);
  }
  
  return this;
}

// DefaultCLI.ts - Universal on() for ALL components
async on(component: string, version: string = 'latest'): Promise<this> {
  // ✅ CLI calculates paths (Path Authority)
  const actualVersion = this.resolveActualVersion(component, version);
  const componentPath = join(this.model.componentsDir, component, actualVersion);
  
  // ✅ Dynamic component loading (works for ANY component type!)
  const targetComponent = await this.loadComponentInstanceInternal(component, actualVersion);
  
  // ✅ CLI tells component where to operate
  targetComponent.setTargetDirectory(componentPath);
  
  // ✅ Store INSTANCE in CLI context (not component context!)
  this.model.context = targetComponent;
  
  return this;
}

// DefaultCLI.ts - Simplified getTestDir()
protected getTestDir(): string {
  // ✅ Path calculated ONCE in init(), stored in model
  const web4ts = this.getWeb4TS();
  const componentPath = web4ts.model.origin || this.model.projectRoot;
  return join(componentPath, 'test');  // ✅ No path doubling!
}

// Usage works everywhere:
web4tscomponent test file
// ✅ Works (no path doubling)

// ✅ Works (inherits on() from DefaultCLI)

pdca on Web4TSComponent 0.3.17.1 test
// ✅ Works (PDCACLI extends DefaultCLI, inherits on())
```
